summary: Defend your space base, survive alien, and conquest many planets!
description:
Explore hostile planets and fight off endless alien hordes in this epic idle tower defense game set in deep space!

You are the captain of a space crew, leading the charge to expand your dominance across the galaxy. Build and upgrade your tower on distant worlds, gain XP after every wave, and unlock powerful boosts to survive longer and conquer new planets.

🛡️ GAME FEATURES:
- Defend your space base against hundreds of alien enemies
- Upgrade your tower pieces and discover powerful combos
- Survive wave after wave to earn XP and strategic resources
- Uncover new tactics with unique perks and tower builds
- Travel to hostile planets and grow your intergalactic power
- Your tower is the last line of defense. Build. Fight. Survive. Become the Star Survivor.
